name: Classic Cappuccino
description: Two shots of house espresso under a thick, silky cap of milk foam.

name: Himalayan Latte
description: Steamed milk and a double shot, warmed with cardamom and a thread of Himalayan honey.

name: Iced Coffee
description: Chilled house coffee over ice, lightly sweetened for warm Kathmandu afternoons.

name: Nepali Mocha
description: Espresso, local cocoa, and warm milk, kept dark so the chocolate stays quiet.

name: Kheer
description: Slow-cooked rice pudding with milk, cardamom, and a few toasted nuts.

name: Sel Roti & Achar
description: Golden rice-flour rings, crisp at the edge, with a small bowl of tangy pickle.

name: Yomari
description: Steamed rice-flour dumplings filled with molasses and sesame, made in small batches.

name: Chicken Chowmein
description: Wok-tossed noodles with chicken and garden vegetables, seasoned the Kathmandu way.

name: Thakali Khana Set
description: Rice, dal, seasonal greens, pickle, and a slow-cooked curry, plated the Thakali way.

name: Chatamari
description: A crisp Newar rice crepe topped with spiced mince, egg, and fresh herbs.

name: Chicken Momo
description: Hand-pleated dumplings filled with spiced chicken, steamed to order with tomato achar.

name: Jhol Momo
description: Steamed chicken momos in a warm sesame-tomato broth, finished with chilli oil.

name: Newari Khaja Set
description: Beaten rice, grilled meat, black soybeans, egg, and house pickle on one platter.

name: Aloo Sadeko
description: Potatoes tumbled with mustard oil, sesame, lemon, and green chilli.

name: Chicken Sekuwa
description: Charcoal-grilled chicken marinated in Nepali spices, with onion and lemon.

name: Himalayan Butter Tea
description: A creamy, gently salted tea inspired by the high hills, served in a small bowl.

name: Masala Chiya
description: Black tea simmered with milk, ginger, cardamom, and clove. The cup we grew up with.
